arguments.command:
cd $GITHUB_WORKSPACE && grep -E "Test Files|Tests " /tmp/val.log; git status --short; npm pack --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -E "total files|package size"; git commit -qam "chore(release): v0.36.0

- pi-durable hosts: Pit hides pi-durable's coding tools from the model by default, honoring allowedTools; new hideTools option

Refs #358" && git push -q -u origin release-0.36.0 2>&1 | tail -1; gh pr create --title "chore(release): v0.36.0" --body "Release v0.36.0. Refs #358.

What's in it (from \`CHANGELOG.md\`): on pi-durable hosts such as pi-action, Pit now hides pi-durable's coding tools (\`read\`, \`write\`, \`edit\`, \`bash\`, \`powershell\`) from the model by default. \`allowedTools\` in \`pit.json\` keeps matching tools visible, and the new \`hideTools\` option sets which tools are hidden. This changes which tools the model sees in existing pi-action workflows, so it's a minor version bump.

Updates the version in \`package.json\` and \`package-lock.json\`, the \`CHANGELOG.md\` heading, and the pinned install example in the README.

Checks run locally (Node 24, npm 12.2.0): \`npm run check\`, \`package:check\`, \`quality:audit\`, \`coverage\` (includes the full test suite), \`npm pack --dry-run\`, and \`npm audit --omit=dev\` (0 vulnerabilities)." 2>&1 | tail -1
